documents.title: Allocation policy
documents.text: FICTIONAL DEMO ONLY. A study pack is priced at CNY 29. CNY 3 per non-refunded pack is reserved for education giving. A full refund reverses CNY 29 in sales and CNY 3 in the reserve. Sales are not donations. The allocation is a commitment, not a completed transfer. Fees and operating costs are outside this simplified example. Opening reserve is zero. No live checkout or partner exists.

documents.title: Refund reconciliation
documents.text: FICTIONAL DEMO ONLY. Reference DEMO-O003. Five of 25 example packs were refunded on 2026-09-06. Sales adjustment: CNY -145. Education allocation adjustment: CNY -15.
